surfaces.condition: A material feature, functionality, behavior, CLI/API, workflow, data, integration, security/privacy, or quality/release change is added or changed.
validation: Update this matrix in the same change with affected surfaces, contracts, documentation, tests, evidence, owners, and projections.
For a purely internal refactor or isolated fix with no matrix impact, record a reviewed no-impact reason in the same change record; omission is not an implicit no-impact decision.

surfaces.path: quality_runner/, quality_evidence_contract/, repo_quality_certifier/, and public documentation
surfaces.condition: scan, audit-coverage, policy, finding, CLI, certification, or public documentation behavior changes
validation: uv run --locked pytest -q
malformed subprocess stdout/stderr decoding regression preserves bounded fleet evidence

pnpm dynamic dependency setup regressions under a compatible Node runtime: exact declared pnpm 10 lock semantics, fleet-owned pnpm 11 frozen-store behavior, prepared Corepack and metadata caches, and canonical-parent local dependency resolution
collision-safe remediation wiring ID regression for normalized path collisions

uv run --locked pytest -q tests/test_code_quality.py::test_test_quality_findings_are_bounded_and_include_remediation_dispositions tests/test_phase1_semantics.py::test_actionability_requires_author_decision_for_test_quality_dispositions
uv run --locked ruff check .
uv run --locked basedpyright

For maturity changes, verify dimension-to-capability-to-pillar aggregation, reverse producer coverage, explicit capability applicability, evidence coverage, missing capabilities, and confirmed-risk-only critical caps.

surfaces.path: quality_runner/onboarding.py, quality_runner/onboarding_quality.py, quality_runner/cli_onboarding.py, packaged onboarding schemas, global repository-onboarding change matrix, tests, plugin contract, .agents/context/commands.md, and operator documentation
surfaces.owner: Quality Runner and workspace onboarding owners
surfaces.condition: Repository onboarding readiness, evidence-envelope, exact-ref, executable-quality, negative-control, producer allowlist, or machine-receipt behavior changes.
validation: uv run --locked pytest -q tests/test_onboarding.py tests/test_entrypoints.py
uv run --locked ruff check quality_runner/onboarding.py quality_runner/onboarding_quality.py quality_runner/cli_onboarding.py tests/test_onboarding.py
uv run --locked basedpyright quality_runner/onboarding.py quality_runner/onboarding_quality.py quality_runner/cli_onboarding.py
Run qr onboarding check against complete, missing, stale-ref, tampered-receipt, warning-bearing, missing-negative-control, and unexplained conditional fixtures.
Confirm the global matrix is valid JSON and declares the same command, evidence schema, receipt schema, quality gates, negative controls, and approved producers.
Confirm the validator is read-only unless --output is explicit and that every non-ready state exits nonzero.

surfaces.owner: Quality Runner and Pronto integration owners
surfaces.condition: Developer-legibility lanes, naming/comment/docstring policy, maturity caps, newcomer evidence, score, or consumer projection changes.
validation: uv run --locked pytest -q tests/test_documentation_visibility.py tests/test_fleet_audit.py tests/test_repository_maturity.py
uv run --locked ruff check quality_runner/fleet/documentation_visibility.py quality_runner/fleet/documentation_visibility_support.py tests/test_documentation_visibility.py
qr fleet audit run --repo-path FIXTURE --standard developer-legibility --json
Pronto route consumer readback exposes developer_legibility without interpreting comments as semantic proof.

surfaces.path: quality_runner/fleet/long_running_tasks.py, fleet standard reports, quality-runner-maturity-feed/v2, and Pronto maturity remediation
surfaces.owner: Quality Runner and Pronto integration owners
surfaces.condition: Long-running task qualification, heartbeat/diagnostic evidence, optimization evidence, maturity dimensions, or downstream triage behavior changes.
validation: uv run --locked pytest -q tests/test_long_running_tasks.py tests/test_fleet_standard_audit.py tests/test_repository_maturity.py tests/test_maturity_feed.py
qr fleet audit run --all --standard long-running-tasks --json
Confirm task names alone remain not_applicable and concrete qualifiers produce two independent findings.
Confirm Pronto imports both dimensions and creates deferred P2 maturity reconciliation actions without treating them as blockers.

surfaces.path: quality_runner/cache_*.py, quality_runner/fleet/cache_design.py, .quality-runner.toml, cache-design standard-report evidence, maturity feed, and Pronto

surfaces.path: quality_runner/fleet/custody.py, quality_runner/cli_fleet.py, quality_runner/cli.py, quality_runner/schemas/custody-validation.schema.json, tests/test_fleet_custody.py, docs/integrations/pronto-custody.md, and Pronto custody consumer readback

explicit repository deadline propagation to inspect, run, verify, and total refresh budgets
